sentences.text: Two peroxisome biogenesis disorders, 1A (Zellweger) and 1B, are both linked to the gene PEX1 in curated databases [e_845be64bf17d] [e_af63d19a002b].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.9 [e_a3d916f13cc6].
For the Zellweger type, a raised level of long chain fatty acids in the blood is an observed feature [e_6f5103e08c5d].
Focal clonic seizures, a type of repeated muscle jerking, are also observed [e_e9eb0b4d1948].
Both observations rest on very small counts in the records, 3 of 3 and 1 of 1 [e_6f5103e08c5d] [e_e9eb0b4d1948].
Tongue fasciculations, which are small twitches of the tongue, are marked as contradicted for this disease, with 1 contradicting record [e_5db843bd3cd5].
These edges do not show any symptoms for type 1B or any studies, funding or patient groups [e_af63d19a002b].
